judge.rationale: The candidate correctly implements `accumulateUsage` and covers all functional edge cases, updating `CHANGELOG.md` and `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` accordingly. However, it misses the fourth acceptance criterion ('Make the signature say the answer... so a reader does not have to open the orchestrator to learn whether it is a sum'), even though it checked that item off in its own `.lore/dod.md` facets. The reference achieved this by renaming the parameter in `OrchestratorHooks.afterModelResponse` (and corresponding local variable and doc blocks in `CLAUDE.md` and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`) from `usage`/`lastUsage` to `totalUsage`, whereas the candidate left `usage?: UsageMetadata` and the misleading `lastUsage` local untouched. Additionally, the candidate placed its new tests in a separate `.acceptance.test.ts` file and exported `accumulateUsage` from `orchestratorHelpers.ts`, whereas the reference kept `accumulateUsage` private to `chatOrchestrator.ts` and added tests to the existing test suite.
